admission_claim_retirement_order: Read exactly 128 U32 descriptor words; check magic/version/flags/reserved/observed size, exact frozen tags and nonzero identity, raw narrow fields and ranges, frozen WeightKey lookup and exact K/N/stage/op, session identity, task sequence, command-specific refs/shape/epochs and 64-bit byte-span bounds. Any rejection here consumes no task or epoch.

LOAD binds first session, retires LOAD task and claims next W epoch, marks W INVALID, reads genuine 128-byte aux model header then q0/q1 512-bit beats, scale 512-bit beats, bias U32. Validate all padded n then g scales, then bias n. Only complete success marks W READY and increments W loads; failure leaves W INVALID and consumed task/epoch.

RUN claims internal A8 epoch and quant task, reads full rows*K activation F32 through 512-bit port into 8 banks, scans each group in 8-lane blocks, computes F32 scale/reciprocal, half RNE and A8. Quant failure retires only quant and leaves PS/dst unclaimed.

After full quant success, claim linear task, next PS and destination epochs; preserve W. Issue m0 ascending then g ascending then n0 tile ascending; per-bank/tile lane_bad prevents cross-tile error suppression. Compute 32 adjacent-tree signed dot terms per lane, scalar R0 product/term/PS order, bias after final group, physical output write and observed trace from actual arithmetic. Full completion marks PS/dst READY; a numerical failure chooses minimum production n0,row,n-lane,g,phase rank and leaves PS/dst INVALID.
CPU top return follows all synchronous C++ writes; actual AXI B response and cycle claims require later RTL.
